summary: Minimal install asks whether to configure more network adapters after the management choice (default no), so leftover NICs are left unconfigured instead of forcing a mode question for each one. When yes, leftover adapters offer skip/dhcp/static; skip stores disabled in the handoff. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Minimal install question order and adapter choices changed: operators now see a Yes/No skip for leftover adapters and skip/dhcp/static when configuring them.

api.reason: Text installer frontend only. The handoff file and nex-config validation are unchanged; mode=disabled is still what leftover skipped adapters write.

roadmap.reason: Installer UX fix only; no milestone status change.

state.reason: Installation-time settings for the host being built. No Controller or pool-scoped durable record is added.

verification.method: python3 tests/integration/installer-text-wizard.py passed (busybox ash lane skipped: busybox not installed). Covers default skip of leftover NICs, yes-path configure with skip/dhcp/static, and management NIC that is not first in discovery order. python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree.
